targets.query:
from(bucket: "processo")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prometheus" and r._field == "edge_up")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["ip"] == "${ip:raw}" or "${ip:raw}" == "")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "processo")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prometheus" and r._field == "edge_up")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["ip"] == "${ip:raw}" or "${ip:raw}" == "")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: int(v: now()) - int(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0 }))

from(bucket: "processo")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "s7_db1" and r._field == "maquina_ligada")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => (r["ip"] == "${ip:raw}" or "${ip:raw}" == "") and (r["db"] == "${db:raw}" or "${db:raw}" == ""))
  |> last()

from(bucket: "processo")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "s7_db1" and r._field == "contador_bom")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => (r["ip"] == "${ip:raw}" or "${ip:raw}" == "") and (r["db"] == "${db:raw}" or "${db:raw}" == ""))
  |> derivative(unit: 1m, nonNegative: false)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> last()

from(bucket: "processo")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "s7_db1" and (r._field == "contador_bom" or r._field == "contador_ruim"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => (r["ip"] == "${ip:raw}" or "${ip:raw}" == "") and (r["db"] == "${db:raw}" or "${db:raw}" == ""))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if exists r.contador_bom and exists r.contador_ruim and (r.contador_bom + r.contador_ruim) > 0 then (float(v: r.contador_bom) / float(v: r.contador_bom + r.contador_ruim)) * 100.0 else 0.0 }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> last()
